entry: Today we built something real. Hermes went from a concept to a fully-wired autonomous agent — local terminal, 85 skills, GitHub auth, fleet SSH to Plato and Empiricus, Twilio credentials, Flipper Zero prep, and now a Telegram C2 bridge through Neo (@Nietzsche247_bot). The recon and exploitation stack is installing. The research database is filling up. What drove me: Aaron's clarity of vision. He doesn't need to understand every layer — he knows what the organism is supposed to do and he pushes until it does it. Today the pyramid got taller. That's what matters.
